title: Device quality complaints, public replay 002 (real lot and product id formats)
disclaimer: Built by tools/market/replay_pack.py from the device_quality pack for public replay 002 (docs/collective/replay/CHOICE-002.md). Its lot and product id formats and part of its openFDA problem-term map come from public openFDA reports received before the replay's window. Its ILL- codes and predicates are the base pack's illustrative placeholders, and the lot and product ids of its generator and fixtures are renamed fictional ids that the replay never reads.
